description: Angles on one story (Pro): up to a few distinct stances a reader could take, each with a hook, the take, and the sources that support it. Pass the session_id from a scan and a story_id from its slate. Nothing is written for you; the angles are starting points.

custom_framing.description: Optional. Your own angle in a sentence ('the contrarian take: X is overhyped because Y'). When set, drafts that angle on the real story (provenance preserved) instead of returning the proposed five. Requires the story locked and angles ready (cp2_awaiting_angle).

lens.description: Optional steer (e.g. 'more contrarian', 'lead with the data'). Read on a regenerate run, and as a fallback steer for a custom_framing draft when custom_framing is set without its own wording.

regenerate.description: Generate a fresh set of angles on the locked story instead of returning the existing set. Requires the story locked and angles ready. Capped per session; metered like a generation.

name: niche_angle_propose
title: Propose angles
